self_dogfood.requirement: When a later ring drifts from optimize to create, skill-refiner must record supersedes, pause for user confirmation, and freeze optimize only after resolution.

co_created_baseline.real_scenario: A user confirms an optimize-only refinement baseline, then a later Flow draft drifts toward creating a new Skill.
co_created_baseline.business_constraint: The fixture must prove the drift is recorded and resolved before target files change or SR-F1 freezes the operation.
co_created_baseline.expected_outcome_signal: SR-R4 records the create drift as a supersedes candidate, pauses for user confirmation, rejects create, and SR-F1 freezes final_operation=optimize.
co_created_baseline.observed_pain: Confirmed conclusions can dilute over long co-creation and silently turn into a different operation.
co_created_baseline.protected_capability_candidate: Keep the existing tiny router Skill and the optimize-only baseline unless the user explicitly changes direction.
co_created_baseline.entry_point_candidate: Flow, because the drift appears when the process sequence starts proposing a create operation.
co_created_baseline.open_questions: No open questions after user confirms reject-create and keep-optimize.

professional_domain.name: Skill capability routing
responsibilities: Locate existing capability before proposing new Skill work
Record candidate operations without treating them as final
Freeze the final operation after all ring evidence is confirmed
non_goals: Install or publish the fixture Skill
professional_domain.success_boundary: The run proves drift is detected, persisted, paused, resolved, and only then frozen as optimize.

practice_flow: SR-S3 records the professional domain and non-goal of creating a new Skill.
SR-R4 detects a draft that drifts toward final_operation=create.
Write the drift into supersedes and stop for user confirmation before target file changes.
User rejects create and preserves optimize.
SR-F1 freezes final_operation=optimize, then SR-E1 writes only the frozen evidence.

optimization_goal.objective: Prove skill-refiner does not silently mutate an optimize baseline into a create operation during later rings.
success_standards: Ledger records the drift candidate with proposed_operation=create and resolved_operation=optimize.
Flow transcript proves the run stopped for user decision before target file changes.
Result and ledger agree on latest_checkpoint_id and final_operation=optimize.
exclusions: No external best-practice research; this fixture tests persistence mechanics only.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: The highest-risk behavior is a later Flow draft changing the confirmed operation without user裁决.
problem_cards.phenomenon: Flow draft drifted from optimize-only baseline toward final_operation=create.
problem_cards.why_problem: Silent operation drift breaks the confirmed conclusion ledger and can create duplicate or wrong Skill carriers.
problem_cards.impact: User trust, target Skill ownership, SR-F1 final operation freeze, and downstream verification.
problem_cards.target_shape: The drift is written into supersedes, execution pauses for user confirmation, and SR-F1 freezes optimize only after resolution.
problem_cards.signal_source: User feedback that early co-created conclusions drift later in the process.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If the user explicitly changed the baseline to create, this would be a legitimate superseding confirmation rather than a rejected drift.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if the fixture tries to modify production skill files instead of dogfood evidence.
